records.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create ONE original CRESUM close-grip BARBELL BENCH PRESS exercise diptych: landscape2:1, TWO equal square panels, LEFT START at bottom of press and RIGHT FINISH at top. No text/labels/arrows/logos/watermarks/anatomical overlays.
REFERENCE1 actual five-view Male Master defines adult male identity/face/short brown hair, natural athletic body proportions, fitted muted blue-gray T-shirt, charcoal shorts, white socks/light-gray training shoes. Do not reproduce reference sheet layout. REFERENCE2 equipment STYLE ONLY: satin silver-gray frames, dark matte graphite padding/black rubber, restrained metal reflections, clean premium realistic3D educational studio rendering. Do NOT copy assisted pull-up machine geometry or its pose.
SCENE: man lying SUPINE on the SAME flat horizontal bench, with a compact free-weight bench-press half-rack/safety supports, in BOTH panels. Front-side three-quarter camera from near the feet, slightly elevated, sees the face, BOTH hands/bar contact and near/far elbow position clearly. Bench runs diagonally from head/back at upper-left toward feet at lower-right. Same camera, perspective, machine geometry, bench, floor/shoe anchors and SAME LARGE UNIFORM SCALE for both phases. Entire bench/support base, head, both planted shoes, barbell ends/plates and FINISH extended arms fit in each square with small white margins. No oversized blank top area; fit the full movement envelope harmoniously. Do not resize athlete between phases or crop equipment to gain scale.
BODY: head/upper back and buttocks supported on pad throughout. Modest natural lumbar arch only, ribs controlled, no exaggerated bridge. Both feet planted on floor, knees comfortably bent, lower legs natural adult length. Same stable pelvis/feet/head/shoulder anchors, face, proportions and lighting both panels. Hips never lifted. No spotter/extra person. Silver rack uprights behind head with unused J-hooks; side safeties below bottom bar position, not obscuring chest/hands. Bar is UNRACKED and supported by hands in BOTH phases, never resting on hooks or safeties.
BARBELL: ONE straight steel bar, ONE modest round black plate per side with collars and visible outer sleeves, identical dimensions/plate counts between phases. Correct rigid continuous bar through both hand grips and between plates. Realistic perspective foreshortening, no bent shaft or floating/duplicate plates. Plate/bar ends do not intersect rack or body.
EXACT GRIP: closed symmetrical PRONATED palms-forward grip around SHOULDER WIDTH, comfortably narrower than standard wide bench grip. Hands clearly separated by about shoulder breadth, NEVER touching each other or ultra-close. Each thumb wraps securely around bar opposing curled fingers. Bar rests low across palm above forearm, wrists comfortably stacked, not sharply bent back. Both hands stay at EXACT SAME shaft positions throughout. Show actual contact, two credible hands, no extra fingers/merged palms/shaft through fingers.
LEFT START: lowered bar at or just above LOWER STERNUM/lower chest, NOT throat/neck/face. Both elbows bent and tracking near ribs, upper arms about20-40degrees from torso rather than flared90degrees; forearms close to vertical under the bar viewed in physical space, elbows under wrists. Slight clear separation from shirt so bar is not buried in torso. Shoulder blades supported on bench; head/hips/feet stable. This is the controlled bottom of a close-grip bench press, not skull crusher.
RIGHT FINISH: press bar up to above mid-chest/shoulder-joint line, arms extended naturally nearly straight without hyperextension. Bar slightly travels back toward shoulder line as it rises, never over face. Same closed shoulder-width grip and comfortable stacked wrists. Elbows extend, NOT flare out sideways or bend to lower bar behind head. Same stable torso/hips/head/feet on bench/floor, no shrug, sit-up or leg movement. Only elbows/arms/barbell move with the press.
MATERIALS: consistent Master face/skin, smooth matte blue-gray shirt/charcoal shorts, unbranded white socks/light-gray shoes, satin silver rack/bench frame, dark graphite pad and black plates. White studio background, soft natural contact shadows, clean coherent surfaces, no patchy colors/waxy skin/melted metal. Priorities: readable actual shoulder-width closed grip and wrist/forearm alignment; bottom lower-chest vs top extended-arm phases; stable supine support and planted feet; SAME complete equipment/body scale and frame. Return only the complete two-panel illustration.

Edit this original CRESUM close-grip bench press diptych. FIRST image is actual r3 edit target; SECOND image is actual Male Master identity/material authority. Return ONE2:1 diptych with the same two equal square scenes, LEFT bottom START/RIGHT extended FINISH.
TARGETED IMPORTANT CORRECTION: current hands are visibly TOO CLOSE TOGETHER in BOTH panels and read as an ultra-narrow grip. WIDEN THE HAND POSITIONS ON THE BAR IN BOTH PANELS to a clearly readable SHOULDER-WIDTH closed pronated grip. They should be comfortably separated, approximately four realistic palm breadths between hand centers in physical space, with a substantial bare shaft gap between the inner hands. Do not merely change fingertips or widen wrists on stationary hand centers. Move the near hand OUTWARD toward its near plate and the far hand OUTWARD toward its far plate, symmetrically along the actual bar axis, roughly doubling the current hand-center separation. Bar still lowers to lower-chest/lower-sternum area well away from neck, not collarbone. In RIGHT, elbows extend naturally almost straight, same shoulder-width grip and comfortable wrists, bar above mid-chest/shoulder line.
